messages.subject: Planning rmr 2.1
parts:
We are firming up plans for rmr 2.1 and your input would be valuable. If you have any features that you would like to see developed, whether already listed in the issue tracker or not, and if you have some reasonable use cases that support introducing those features; or if you have some use cases that are not particularly well supported, that require workarounds or inelegant code or that appear to run excessively slowly, even if you don't have a clear idea of what changes in rmr could address those situations, this is a good time to come forward. Keep in mind this is a minor version, therefore, following the definitions of Semantic Versioning, we are going to delay any non-backward compatible changes. That doesn't mean we can't discuss more long term changes, just don't be disappointed if they have to wait until 3.0. If you check the issue tracker you can see that some issues are already associated with the 2.1 milestone, those are completely tentative and can be changed. Thanks


Antonio
